# Furmacy

> Furmacy is a free-to-download, privacy-first iPhone app for pet medication reminders, dose history, refill tracking, weight and symptom logs, vet records, and Pro upgrades for larger chronic-care routines.

Furmacy is made by Huggler Holdings LLC. It is designed for pet caregivers managing senior pets, chronic medications, multi-pet households, and shared care with family or sitters. Furmacy helps organize care and reduce missed-dose confusion, but it is not veterinary advice, medication advice, treatment advice, supplements, or alternative medicine.

- Platform: iOS (iPhone)
- Status: available on the Apple App Store
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/furmacy-pet-med-tracker/id6767069388?uo=4
- Maker: Huggler Holdings LLC
- Contact: contact@furmacy.org
- Website: https://furmacy.org/

## Core value

Furmacy turns scattered pet-care work into a clear daily system:

- Current state: phone alarms, sticky notes, whiteboards, text threads, and memory.
- Solution state: a Today view for due doses, clear Given / Skip status, refill tracking, and records tied to each pet.
- Free value: download the iPhone app and try it with one pet for free.
- Pro value: unlimited pets, unlimited active medications, full adherence history, expanded document storage, and iCloud sync across Apple devices.

## Subscription options

Furmacy Pro has:

- Furmacy Pro Weekly
- Furmacy Pro Annual with a 14-day trial for eligible subscribers

Exact live pricing is shown by the App Store before purchase. The free plan supports one pet so caregivers can try the app before deciding whether Pro is useful.

## What Furmacy does

- Medication reminders and dose tracking - schedule meds and mark each dose Given or Skipped.
- Status clarity - see Pending, Missed, Given, and Skipped states.
- Refills and routine care - track refill counts, prescribing vets, instructions, and recurring care.
- Weight and symptom logging - record patterns over time.
- Vet records - store labs, prescriptions, vaccines, discharge notes, insurance, boarding, and travel records.
- Care handoff - help family and sitters understand what has already happened.
- Pro upgrades - unlimited pets and medications, full history, expanded documents, and iCloud sync.

## Who it is for

- Senior-pet owners.
- Chronic medication caregivers.
- Multi-pet households.
- People coordinating care with partners, family, sitters, clinics, fosters, or rescues.
- Care routines involving diabetes, CKD/kidney disease, seizures, Cushing's, arthritis and mobility, senior care, multiple conditions, post-surgery recovery, and complex medication schedules.

## Privacy

- Pet and health data is kept on the device by default.
- No account is required to start using the app.
- iCloud sync is a Pro feature for Apple-device continuity through the user's private iCloud.
- RevenueCat manages Pro purchase status and entitlement restores.
- Apple's standard AdServices attribution token may be sent to RevenueCat for Apple Ads campaign reporting.
- Pet names, medication details, dose history, notes, photos, scans, documents, and health entries are not sent to RevenueCat.
- No in-app ads, IDFA use, or behavioral advertising profile.
- Furmacy is an organizational tool and is not a replacement for veterinary care.

## FAQ

### What is Furmacy?
Furmacy is a free-to-download, privacy-first iPhone app that helps pet caregivers manage medication reminders, dose history, refills, weight and symptom tracking, and vet records. You can start with one pet for free, and Furmacy Pro unlocks unlimited pets, unlimited active medications, full history, iCloud sync, and expanded records.

### What does Furmacy Pro include?
Furmacy Pro unlocks unlimited pets, unlimited active medications, full adherence history, an expanded document vault, iCloud sync across Apple devices, and fuller records for ongoing care.

### Can Furmacy help with chronic conditions like diabetes or kidney disease?
Yes. Furmacy is designed for complex, ongoing care, including diabetes, CKD/kidney disease, seizures, Cushing's, arthritis and mobility, senior care, and pets with multiple conditions.

### Is Furmacy veterinary advice?
No. Furmacy helps organize routines and records. It is not veterinary advice. Always follow your veterinarian's instructions and contact your vet for medical concerns.

### How much does Furmacy cost?
Furmacy is free to download and supports one pet for free. Furmacy Pro has weekly and annual subscription options, and annual includes a 14-day trial for eligible subscribers. Exact live pricing is shown by the App Store before purchase.

### How do I get Furmacy?
Download Furmacy from the App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/furmacy-pet-med-tracker/id6767069388?uo=4.

### Who makes Furmacy?
Huggler Holdings LLC. Contact: contact@furmacy.org.
